review.description: triage-inbox contract and its existing scenarios retain main behavior; shared verification tooling causes conservative review impact.
review.implementation: Compared triage-inbox registry entry and authored flow document against main: no implementation, UI reference, scenario or behavior changes. Main browser layout and per-test state ownership are retained exactly.
review.tests: Existing triage-inbox assertion mappings and bodies are unchanged from main; mandatory tooling gains local inventory, status and retained-discovery regressions. Fixture verification does not close real-host acceptance gaps.
